narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed in the morning hours and continued into the evening hours on September 20th. There were multiple reports of flash flooding across the area.
ev: Tatum Road was flooded and impassable.
Minor flooding was reported in the Hampshire Area.
Flood waters covered Old Highway 46 at Missionary Ridge Road.
Jacobs Road was flooded and impassable.
Carters Creek Pike at Harlan Road was impassable due to high water.
Several roads were flooded and impassable across north-central Maury County, including Sulphur Springs Branch Road and B. Dodson Road.
Photo showed Hudson Road was flooded near Kirk Road.
Flood waters covered Highway 242 in Iron City.
Cleburne Road at Petty Lane was flooded and impassable.
Several roadways in northern Maury County were damaged and closed due to flooding.
Flooding was reported around Summertown Market on Highway 20.
Leatherwood Road near Highway 50 was flooded.
